zh.label: 平静
zh.text: 你好，很高兴见到你。我们慢慢说，不用着急。
zh.direction: 自然、平静，像面对面聊天。

zh.label: 喜悦
zh.text: 太好了，这件事终于完成了。我想把这个好消息告诉你。
zh.direction: 轻微喜悦，自然口语，不唱歌。

zh.label: 认真
zh.text: 请先听我说完，这件事很重要，我们需要一起想办法。
zh.direction: 认真坚定，吐字清楚，不喊叫。

en.label: Calm
en.text: Hello. It is good to see you. Take your time, there is no rush.
en.direction: Speak naturally and calmly, like a face-to-face conversation.

en.label: Happy
en.text: That is wonderful. We finally finished it, and I wanted to share the good news.
en.direction: Gently cheerful natural speech. Do not sing.

en.label: Serious
en.text: Please hear me out. This matters, and we need to find a way forward together.

zh.label: 平静
zh.text: 你终于回来了。我一直在这里等你。
zh.direction: 平静克制，像自然的剧情对白。

zh.label: 坚定
zh.text: 我已经想好了。无论发生什么，我都会走下去。
zh.direction: 坚定但不过分激动，不喊叫。

zh.label: 低落
zh.text: 我明白你的意思，只是还有些话，不知道该怎么说。
zh.direction: 轻微失落，低声但吐字清楚。

en.label: Calm
en.text: You are finally back. I have been waiting here for you.

en.label: Determined
en.text: I have made up my mind. Whatever happens, I will keep going.

en.label: Sad
en.text: I understand what you mean. There are still things I do not know how to say.
en.direction: Gently sad, quiet but clear speech.

zh.label: 讲述
zh.text: 清晨的光照进房间，新的一天从这里开始。

zh.label: 说明
zh.text: 接下来，我们会用三个简单的步骤，说明这个过程。
zh.direction: 清楚易懂的说明，不夸张。

zh.label: 收束
zh.text: 感谢你听到这里，我们下次再见。
zh.direction: 温和自然地结束，保留完整句尾。

en.label: Narration
en.text: Morning light fills the room. A new day begins here.
en.direction: Natural narration at a moderate pace.

en.label: Explanation
en.text: Next, we will explain this process in three simple steps.

en.label: Closing
en.text: Thank you for listening. I look forward to seeing you next time.
en.direction: Warm natural closing. Finish the last word clearly.
